headline: Strong core operating performance; FY27 growth guidance reaffirmed

highlights: While reported AUM growth (18.5% YoY) appeared soft due to an accounting shift in the recognition policy, the underlying momentum remains intact, supported by geographically diversified branch network that mitigates single-state concentration risk.

Backed by industry- first market segmentation across urban (focused on scale) and emerging (focus on yields), alongside a strong underwriting policy (~25bps credit cost cross-cycle), management reaffirmed its guidance of 20% YoY AUM growth and >20% YoY disbursements growth for FY27.

Outperforming spread pressure with resilient growth; thus, successfully defying concern growth/spread in AHFC space By sustaining ~20% AUM growth trajectory at scale, Aadhar has effectively addressed prevailing market concerns about the long-term viability of high growth and mid-teen RoE amid intensifying competition in the affordable housing finance (AHF) space.
Notably, Aadhar maintains its 20% AUM and PAT growth targets for FY27.
valuation: Notably, Aadhar maintains its 20% AUM and PAT growth targets for FY27.

Leveraging its core competencies in deep distribution, competitive pricing, and granular demographic expertise, management has set a strategic target to reach INR 500bn in AUM by FY29, implying a 20% growth rate over the next three years.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
